projects.title: Ascension
projects.alt: A golden figure floating in a shaft of light above a dark, flooded cavern hung with stalactites
projects.description: A golden figure rises through a shaft of light in a flooded cavern, framed by hanging stalactites and teal-lit brickwork.

projects.title: Terra
projects.alt: A lime soda can bursting through a splash of water, limes and leaves in a Spanish-language advert layout
projects.description: A lime soda visualised two ways: a Spanish-language poster, and a 10-second spot of splashes, condensation and a pull-tab close-up.

projects.title: Resonance
projects.alt: A kneeling figure at the end of a tunnel of glowing magenta rings reflected in still water at blue hour
projects.description: A kneeling figure at the end of a tunnel of glowing magenta rings, doubled in the still water of a blue-hour shoreline.

projects.title: Pendulum
projects.alt: Rows of glowing pink and amber orbs swinging on long strings against a dark background
projects.description: A wave of glowing pink and amber orbs swings on long strings, drifting in and out of phase over a single 104-second cycle.

projects.title: The Last Memory
projects.alt: Two figures sitting face to face in a dark, overgrown temple courtyard with a small glowing bloom in the doorway
projects.description: Two figures sit facing each other in a dark, overgrown temple courtyard, lit only by a small bioluminescent bloom in the doorway.

projects.title: Zest & Zing
projects.alt: Two blood-orange soda cans surrounded by lightning, splashes and orange slices in a bold advert layout
projects.description: A blood-orange soda in two parts: a 2024 poster of crackling lightning and splashes, and a 2025 spot of pours and pull-tab close-ups.

projects.title: Fractured World
projects.alt: A giant figure traced in electric-blue light rising from a rocky surface in space, holding a small planet
projects.description: A giant figure traced in electric-blue light rises from a rocky surface into open space, holding a small planet in one hand.

projects.title: Fruits & Juice
projects.alt: A glass of juice with ice cubes and a straw between an apple and an orange under soft pink light
projects.description: A study in glass, ice and liquid: a glass of juice with ice and a straw, set between an apple and an orange under soft pink light.

projects.title: Genesis
projects.alt: A crouching figure in a flooded colonnade facing a blazing golden disc where two hands cradle an egg
projects.description: A figure crouches in a flooded colonnade before a blazing golden disc, where two hands cradle an egg.

projects.title: Crawling
projects.alt: A figure covered in rippling red and blue light crawling towards the camera across a dark floor
projects.description: A figure wrapped in rippling red and blue light crawls towards the camera across a dark, reflective floor.

projects.title: Wanderers
projects.alt: Two pale figures walking over golden sand dunes under a low sun, casting long shadows
projects.description: Two pale figures cross golden dunes under a low sun, their shadows stretching long across the sand.

projects.title: Silk Lotus
projects.alt: A face serum dropper bottle on pink water among lotus flowers in a Chinese and English beauty advert
projects.description: A face serum staged on still pink water among lotus flowers, laid out as a bilingual Chinese and English beauty advert.

projects.title: Temple of Mind
projects.alt: A seated figure on a circular platform above the clouds with a red arched bridge rising to a torii gate
projects.description: A lone figure rests on a circular platform above the clouds, where a red arched bridge climbs to a torii gate.

projects.title: Water Pillar
projects.alt: A spiralling column of blue water twisting upwards against a pale sky
projects.description: A column of water spirals up from the ground and twists into shape against a pale sky, then fades out to restart the loop.

projects.title: Limbo
projects.alt: A figure draped in a white sheet standing on still water while bodies hang limp in the misty air
projects.description: A draped, faceless figure stands on mirror-still water while bodies hang motionless in the misty air around it.

projects.title: Citrus Crown
projects.alt: An orange juice bottle on wet rock among sliced oranges and palm leaves in a French-language advert
projects.description: A premium orange juice bottle on wet rock among sliced oranges and palm leaves, laid out as a French-language summer advert.

projects.title: Departure
projects.alt: A small boat on calm water between two wooded islands at sunset, with birds in the sky
projects.description: A small boat waits between two wooded islands as the sun sets over calm water.

projects.title: Snowbound
projects.alt: A lone figure meditating in rolling snow during snowfall, with a distant stone tower
projects.description: A lone figure meditates in a field of drifting snow, a distant stone tower just visible through the haze.

projects.title: Canopy
projects.alt: An aerial view of dense green forest broken by pale rock outcrops, with birds in a bright sky
projects.description: An aerial view over a dense forest canopy broken by pale rock outcrops, with birds circling in a bright sky.

projects.title: A-Frame House
projects.alt: A black A-frame cabin in deep snow surrounded by pine trees in low winter sun
projects.description: A black A-frame cabin half-buried in snow among pine trees, caught in low winter sunlight.
